title: I ordered "Dietary Happy Cat" but didn't get any treats or food. Only toys.
text:
I wanted to try this out since it said it'd be toys, treats and other goodies. Mine was just small plush toys with cat nip in them. I don't mind some toys, but I can easily throw a sock in some cat nip and have my cats go to town on it.

I ordered "Dietary Happy Cat" in hopes of, you know, getting diet food/treats to see how my cats liked them and buy bigger quantities to continue on.

Also, the one toy (wand) was broken when I unboxed it. So I need to repair it before I can play with the cats.

The cats enjoyed the toys the day I opened it, but the cat nip weakens so quickly, so overall, this was an absolute waste of money and I cancelled my subscription.
label: negative
